description: Recursively enumerates files using opendir/readdir in directories ~/Documentos_Teste, ~/Documentos, ~/Downloads, ~/Imagens, and /mnt, filtering by extensions .xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .txt, .csv, .jpg, .png, .db, .backup, .psd, .zip, .rar. Returns a dynamically allocated array of absolute file paths.
name: scan_target_files
